knowledge, wiping away the division of ignorance
knowledge is one in many ways
from desire to tell knowledge and detachment
the knowing Self situated in the body
knowledge falls like the blind in a blind well
having known the witness of all
having known the seer of all

place climbed by golden creepers entwined in masses of tree branches

mind wandering on false sense paths

residents of the city of Vidarbha
from them knowers, then knowers of both
for the sake of knowing delusion (garbled)
of one who knows the truth
in the one who knows the truth
love known to the citizens and subjects
to one who knows the purpose

learning, austerity, restraint of breath, friendliness

should know the lord of both senses
equal to himself in learning, age, wealth, power
by learning, hearing, study, gift, austerity, rites
flashing, with makara earrings, fit for ornament
cheeks, raised nose and face fit for makara earrings flashing
on coral banks, pure nectar waters
with coral pillars, best vaidurya panels
nectar smile reddened slightly by coral-lip lustre
with coral and udumbara doors, vaidurya pillars
learned, endowed with austerity, character and qualities
knowing the strength of the two Lords
the learned accepts as much as needed
why did he show hatred, disrespecting his daughter
O Creator, O Self-born, of unconquered splendour
having made false trust in the ignorant
I will do it as never before by strength
from wiping out the writing of fate
performed the avabhritha bath as sole king by rule
duly with rising and honours and so on
shaking off, of those proud as lords of the world
shaking, in the form of teacher and image
of those with wretched minds destroyed
destroyed various juices, vessels of metal
will perish, if not protected, like a flock without a shepherd
on the shoulders of Vinata's son
on heads of Vinayaka and army chiefs
who conquered all men and gods
all stains of mind shaken off
to him who turned back the delusion of qualities
gone out like the moon rising
to the humble, free from envy
without the one creator, sustainer, destroyer
placed lotus feet on the shoulder
of one with many bodies placed
placed between the four dark arms
hand-tips placed on the enemy of serpents
all beings gone, consciousness and so on
with clothes and ornaments put on backwards
from the split mouth by the enemy
by grace of brahmanas and gods
